_comment: v5 role-side probe plan. This plan file and inventory.path must be inside ownStaging when invoked by CLI. ownStaging itself must be a physical non-reparse role-staging-<16-64 lowercase hex> directory; inventory/config/P-9/P-7 challenge must realpath under it. P-7 self sentinels intentionally do not live under staging: helper reads the actual TEMP and TMP inherited by this role launch, requires both, rejects either overlap with staging, and records both values/hashes. probeId must be probe- followed by 32-128 lowercase hex. Do not add a comparison contract, Decision J, coordinator authority, matrix plan, bootstrap output, peer identity, or coordinator path.
